APP.TITLE: e-ID app
APP.SUBTITLE: Read your electronic ID card data

HOME.MACOS_STEP_1: After downloading and unzipping the app:
HOME.MACOS_STEP_2: In Finder, Control-click (or right-click) the app and choose Open.
HOME.MACOS_STEP_3: Select Open again in the warning dialog.
HOME.MACOS_STEP_4: If macOS blocks it, open it once, then go to System Settings > Privacy & Security and select Open Anyway.
HOME.MACOS_TRUST: Only do this if you trust the source.

VIEWER.TITLE: e-ID Card
VIEWER.SUBTITLE: Card data read from the eID card reader
VIEWER.NO_DATA_LINK: No card data in the link.
VIEWER.READ_FAILED: Failed to read card data from the link.
